sourceEvidence.title: Sentinel Specialty Systems Engineering SSE Supplier Validation Section Manager 2
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Bachelor’s Degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) with 8 years of related experience; 6 years of related experience with a Master’s degree.
* Must be a US Citizen with an active U.S. Government Secret Clearance with an investigation date within the last 6 years.
* Must have the ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) approval within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business needs.
* Experience managing to cost and schedule as a Control Account Manager (CAM)/Work Package Lead (WPL) or equivalent.
* Experience with Program and/or Project management, managing multidisciplinary teams through complex engineering problems.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Top Secret clearance with SCI within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business needs
* Experience developing or executing structured risk management processes (identification, analysis, mitigation, monitoring, reporting).
* Experience with supply chain security frameworks (e.g., NIST SP 800-161) and defense/critical-infrastructure environments.
* Experience with suppliers, subcontractors, and cross-functional teams (Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Configuration Management, Program Management).
